title: Capability-Conditioned Agent Strategy
one_liner: A useful agent practice for one model can become a poor default for another; scope every do and don’t to measured capability and task.
problem: Agent guidance often labels a prompt, tool set or context strategy as universally good. Yet model ability is uneven across coding tasks, and the same intervention can help a weaker agent while slowing or hurting a stronger one. A single model leaderboard score or vague “frontier” label hides the model, harness, task and context conditions that determine the result.
solution: Publish guidance as a versioned model–harness–task matrix. For each recommendation, record the exact model/version, agent interface, task family, context budget, baseline, outcome metric, sample size and evaluation date. Make the stance explicit for each measured condition: do, don’t or conditional. For example, in one controlled 2026 study, predefined workspace tools were a do for a shell-weak 30B model but a don’t relative to bash-only for a bash-capable 550B model on the same repository issue benchmark. Re-test after model, harness or task changes. Use a global capability index only to find candidates; local task-specific evidence decides which advice applies.

model_guidance.task: Repository issue resolution when the model struggles to operate a shell
model_guidance.evidence: Fan et al. (2026): Nemotron-3 30B solved 25.2% of SWE-bench Verified tasks with predefined tools versus 10.2% with bash-only in their 128k/T4 harness.
model_guidance.note: Provide a reliable read/search/edit interface in this measured setting; verify transfer to the chosen compact model.

model_guidance.task: Repository issue resolution when the model is proficient with Bash
model_guidance.evidence: Fan et al. (2026): Nemotron-3 550B solved 69.4% with bash-only versus 65.8% with the full tool set on SWE-bench Verified, with lower cost.
model_guidance.note: Do not impose the full predefined workspace tool set as a default for this measured model–harness–task pair; other strong models can differ.

model_guidance.task: Current frontier coding agent on a specific repository workflow
model_guidance.evidence: ContextBench and scaffold studies report model–harness and task effects, but the 30B/550B crossover was not tested on every current frontier model.
model_guidance.note: Run the local evaluation before assigning a do or don’t; record model version, harness, task and date.
